hindi: उदर-दास को छोड़कर, आर्य-प्राण, व्यवहार को अप्राप्त शूद्र को बिक्री या बन्धक में ले जाने वाले अपने जन का दण्ड बारह पण है; वैश्य को दुगुना, क्षत्रिय को तिगुना, ब्राह्मण को चौगुना।
english: Excluding a belly-slave, for one of his own people who brings to sale or pledge a Śūdra of ārya life who has not reached dealings, the penalty [is] twelve paṇas; [for] a Vaiśya, double; [for] a Kṣatriya, three-fold; [for] a Brāhmaṇa, four-fold.
notes: udara-dāsa is rendered literally 'belly-slave' (a slave for the belly); sense not imported. ārya-prāṇa taken as a bahuvrīhi 'whose life/self is ārya', literal; the sense is doubtful. aprāpta-vyavahāra = who has not reached dealings (a minor, 'legal capacity', in notes only). sva-janasya is ambiguous: it may go with nayataḥ ('one of his own people who brings') or describe the person sold ('a Śūdra of his own people'). The accusatives vaiśyam, kṣatriyam, brāhmaṇam are elliptical; the penalty is the multiple of twelve paṇas.
lines_deva: उदर.दास.वर्जम् आर्य.प्राणम् अप्राप्त.व्यवहारं शूद्रं विक्रय.आधानं नयतः स्व.जनस्य द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, वैश्यं द्वि.गुणः, क्षत्रियं त्रि.गुणः, ब्राह्मणं चतुर्.गुणः
lines_iast: udara.dāsa.varjam ārya.prāṇam aprāpta.vyavahāraṃ śūdraṃ vikraya.ādhānaṃ nayataḥ sva.janasya dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, vaiśyaṃ dvi.guṇaḥ, kṣatriyaṃ tri.guṇaḥ, brāhmaṇaṃ catur.guṇaḥ

hindi: पराये जन का प्रथम, मध्यम, सर्वोच्च और वध — दण्ड हैं, और खरीदने वालों तथा सुनने वालों का।
english: Of another's people, the penalties [are] the first, the middle, the highest and death; and of the buyers and the hearers.
notes: para-janasya is a bare genitive (the seller of a stranger, or the stranger himself; not settled). The four-member dvandva pūrva-madhyama-uttama-vadhāḥ is read as first, middle, highest [penalties] and killing, without saying which applies to whom (a 'respectively' is not in the Sanskrit). śrotṛ = hearer, literal; the sense (e.g. witnesses/consenting listeners) is not stated.
lines_deva: पर.जनस्य पूर्व.मध्यम.उत्तम.वधा दण्डाः, क्रेतृ.श्रोतॄणां च

hindi: म्लेच्छों के लिए सन्तान को बेचने या बन्धक रखने में दोष नहीं है।
english: For the mlecchas [there is] no fault in selling or pledging offspring.
notes: prajā = offspring (alternatively 'people'); the literal 'offspring' is used. Predicate is supplied only as a bare copula.
lines_deva: म्लेच्छानाम् अदोषः प्रजां विक्रेतुम् आधातुं वा
lines_iast: mlecchānām adoṣaḥ prajāṃ vikretum ādhātuṃ vā

hindi: किन्तु आर्य का दास-भाव कदापि नहीं।
english: But by no means [is there] a slave-state of an ārya.
notes: Verbless sentence; predicate not supplied in Hindi.
lines_deva: न त्व् एव-आर्यस्य दास.भावः

hindi: अथवा आर्य को बन्धक रखकर, कुल-बन्धन में, आर्यों की आपत्ति में, और निष्क्रय प्राप्त करके, बालक या सहायता देने वाले को पहले छुड़ा लें।
english: Or, having pledged an ārya, in a family bond, in an adversity of the āryas, and having obtained a ransom, [they] should first redeem the child or the giver of help.

text_flags.why: bare stem cannot stand beside locative āpadi; kula.bandhane or kula.bandhanam (accusative, in apposition to āryam) possible (possible)

notes: The subject of niṣkrīṇīran (plural) and of ādhāya is not stated; left unstated. 'kula-bandhana' is kept as printed and read as a locative (see text_flags); if it is a compound member it would be 'family-bond' with the next word. The structure 'in a family bond, in the adversity of the āryas' is uncertain. niṣkraya = ransom (glossary). Several readings of who redeems whom are possible.
lines_deva: अथवा-आर्यम् आधाय कुल.बन्धन आर्याणाम् आपदि, निष्क्रयं च-अधिगम्य बालं साहाय्य.दातारं वा पूर्वं निष्क्रीणीरन्
lines_iast: athavā-āryam ādhāya kula.bandhana āryāṇām āpadi, niṣkrayaṃ ca-adhigamya bālaṃ sāhāyya.dātāraṃ vā pūrvaṃ niṣkrīṇīran

hindi: एक बार स्वयं को बन्धक रखने वाला भागा हुआ डूबे; दूसरे के द्वारा बन्धक रखा गया, दो बार; दोनों, एक बार, दूसरे देश की ओर मुख किए हुए।
english: One who has pledged himself once, [and] has run away, should sink; one pledged by another, twice; both, once, facing another territory.
notes: Elliptical: 'dvir' and 'sakṛd ubhau ...' lack their own predicate; the earlier verb sīdet is carried over, left unsupplied. The compound sakṛd.ātma.ādhātā is joined as printed (sakṛt may instead go with niṣpatitaḥ 'run away once'). sīdet (√sad) is rendered literally 'should sink'; its sense (e.g. be lost/ruined, lose the price) is not stated. viṣaya = territory (glossary).
lines_deva: सकृद्.आत्म.आधाता निष्पतितः सीदेत्, द्विर् अन्येन-आहितकः, सकृद् उभौ पर.विषय.अभिमुखौ
lines_iast: sakṛd.ātma.ādhātā niṣpatitaḥ sīdet, dvir anyena-āhitakaḥ, sakṛd ubhau para.viṣaya.abhimukhau

words.gloss: of one who takes away wealth

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. apa-√hṛ

hindi: धन हर लेने वाले का अथवा दास का आर्य-भाव हर लेने वाले का आधा दण्ड है।
english: Of one who takes away wealth, or of one who takes away the ārya-state of a slave, [there is] half the penalty.
notes: dāsasya may also go with vitta-apahāriṇaḥ ('one who takes away the slave's wealth'); both readings possible. 'half the penalty' (ardha-daṇḍa) is literal; the full penalty is not named in the unit.
lines_deva: वित्त.अपहारिणो वा दासस्य-आर्य.भावम् अपहरतो ऽर्ध.दण्डः

words.gloss: of the runaways, the deceased and those in calamity

hindi: भाग गए हुओं, मृतकों और व्यसन वालों का बन्धक रखने वाला मूल्य अपनाए।
english: Of the runaways, the deceased and those in calamity (vyasana), the pledger should take on the price.
notes: vyasanin could also be 'given to vice' (as in 4.6); 'in calamity' chosen. bhaj = take on, doubtful as in 4.1 (alternatively 'share'). Which party is the ādhātā (the one who pledges the person, or receives him) and who bears the price is not stated.
lines_deva: निष्पतित.प्रेत.व्यसनिनाम् आधाता मूल्यं भजेत

words.gloss: causing to take the deceased, excrement, urine and leftovers
causing the destruction of the price
of the nurse, the attendant, the ardha-sītika and the servant

hindi: बन्धक रखे गए का मृतक, मल, मूत्र और जूठन ग्रहण कराना, नग्न नहलाना, दण्ड भेजना और स्त्रियों का अतिक्रमण — मूल्य का नाश करने वाला है; और धात्री, परिचारिका, अर्ध-सीतिक और उपचारिकाओं का — मोक्ष करने वाला है।
english: Causing the pledged one to take the deceased, excrement, urine and leftovers; causing [him] to bathe naked; sending of penalty; and transgression of women — [these are] causing the destruction of the price; and of the nurse, the attendant, the ardha-sītika and the servant, [it is] release-making.
notes: Low confidence throughout. 'preta-viṇ-mūtra-ucchiṣṭa' read as a list (deceased, excrement, urine, leftovers); preta could also qualify 'excrement of a corpse'. grāhaṇa = causing to take (caus. √grah), literal. daṇḍa-preṣaṇa = 'sending of punishment', literal; alternative 'sending a rod/staff'; sense not stated. atikramaṇa = transgression (against women), its sense not stated. The second clause (dhātrī ... mokṣa-karam) has no stated link to the acts listed before; the same acts seem to be meant, with release as the result for those women. ardha-sītika kept untranslated (obscure); dhātrī, paricārikā, upacārikā are rendered by their plain senses (nurse, attendant, servant), the final -ā being lost in compound. viṇ is regular (viṣ before m).
lines_deva: प्रेत.विण्.मूत्र.उच्छिष्ट.ग्राहणम् आहितस्य नग्न.स्नापनं दण्ड.प्रेषणम् अतिक्रमणं च स्त्रीणां मूल्य.नाश.करं, धात्री.परिचारिक.अर्ध.सीतिक.उपचारिकाणां च मोक्ष.करम्
lines_iast: preta.viṇ.mūtra.ucchiṣṭa.grāhaṇam āhitasya nagna.snāpanaṃ daṇḍa.preṣaṇam atikramaṇaṃ ca strīṇāṃ mūlya.nāśa.karaṃ, dhātrī.paricārika.ardha.sītika.upacārikāṇāṃ ca mokṣa.karam

hindi: उपचारक का, अभिप्रजात का अपक्रमण सिद्ध है।
english: Established [is] the going away of the attendant, of the abhiprajāta.
notes: abhiprajāta is obscure (abhi-pra-√jan, literally 'born forth/upon') and kept untranslated. 'siddham' could also mean 'valid' or 'accomplished'. Whether the three genitive/nominative items form one phrase is uncertain; a commentary would be needed.
lines_deva: सिद्धम् उपचारकस्य-अभिप्रजातस्य-अपक्रमणम्

hindi: अनिच्छुक धात्री या आहितिका के पास, अपने वश वाली के पास, जाने वाले का प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है; पराये वश वाली के पास, मध्यम।
english: For one who goes to a nurse or an āhitikā, unwilling, [if she is] in one's own power, the first fine for rashness; [if] in another's power, the middle.
notes: gam with accusative of a woman: the text states only 'goes to'; the sexual sense is not translated. sva-vaśā = in one's own power (vaśa could also be 'will'). The sentence order is rearranged for readability; 'sva-vaśām / para-vaśām' agree with the woman. 'madhyamaḥ' is bare (the middle), no noun supplied. āhitikā kept untranslated (glossary 4.9).
lines_deva: धात्रीम् आहितिकां वा-अकामां स्व.वशां गच्छतः पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः, पर.वशां मध्यमः
lines_iast: dhātrīm āhitikāṃ vā-akāmāṃ sva.vaśāṃ gacchataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, para.vaśāṃ madhyamaḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. caus. √duṣ

hindi: कन्या या आहितिका को स्वयं या दूसरे के द्वारा दूषित करने वाले का मूल्य का नाश, शुल्क, और उसका दुगुना दण्ड है।
english: For one who defiles a girl or an āhitikā, himself or by another: loss of the price, the śulka, and a penalty double that.

text_flags.why: possible: caus. of √duṣ is dūṣayati (long ū); short u in the printed form looks like a typo
'dvu' is not a numeral stem; dvi-guṇa 'double' is expected (cf. 1: dvi.guṇaḥ), so u for i is a typo

notes: śulka kept untranslated here (the glossary gives 'bride-price' only for 4.12); 'tat' in tad-dvi-guṇa most naturally refers to the śulka. Which of the three items go to whom is not stated. kanyā = girl (glossary 3.5). 'tad.dvu.guṇaś ca' has the plain visarga lost by sandhi (ś before c).
lines_deva: कन्याम् आहितिकां वा स्वयम् अन्येन वा दुषयतो मूल्य.नाशः शुल्कं तद्.द्वु.गुणश् च दण्डः
lines_iast: kanyām āhitikāṃ vā svayam anyena vā duṣayato mūlya.nāśaḥ śulkaṃ tad.dvu.guṇaś ca daṇḍaḥ

hindi: आत्म-विक्रय करने वाले की सन्तान को आर्य जाने।
english: One should know the offspring of a self-seller [to be] ārya.
notes: prajā = offspring (alternatively 'people'). The subject of vidyāt is unstated; 'to be' is supplied in brackets only.
lines_deva: आत्म.विक्रयिणः प्रजाम् आर्यां विद्यात्

words.gloss: not opposed to the master's work

hindi: स्वामी के कर्म से अविरुद्ध, स्वयं पाया हुआ पाए; और पैतृक दाय।
english: [He] should obtain what is self-acquired, not opposed to the master's work, and the paternal inheritance.
notes: The subject is unstated (the enslaved person of unit 13 is understood); left unstated in Hindi. ātma-adhigata: ātman = self. karma = work (service). 'what is' is the supplied neuter.
lines_deva: आत्म.अधिगतं स्वामि.कर्म.अविरुद्धं लभेत, पित्र्यं च दायम्
lines_iast: ātma.adhigataṃ svāmi.karma.aviruddhaṃ labheta, pitryaṃ ca dāyam

hindi: और मूल्य से आर्यत्व को पहुँचे।
english: And by the price [he] should go to ārya-hood.
notes: Subject unstated. gam rendered literally ('go to'); sense is 'attain'.
lines_deva: मूल्येन च-आर्यत्वं गच्छेत्

words.gloss: the belly-slave and the pledged one

hindi: इससे उदर-दास और आहितक की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the belly-slave and the pledged one are explained.
notes: Formula 'tena X vyākhyātau' (glossary 4.1/3.6). 'tena' refers to the rules just stated (units 13-15).
lines_deva: तेन-उदर.दास.आहितकौ व्याख्यातौ

hindi: और उसका निष्क्रय प्रक्षेप के अनुरूप है।
english: And his ransom [is] in accordance with the putting-in (prakṣepa).
notes: prakṣepa (literally 'casting/putting in') is kept literal; the intended sense (e.g. what was paid in, the amount laid out) is not stated. 'asya' = 'his' (the person of the preceding units).
lines_deva: प्रक्षेप.अनुरूपश् च-अस्य निष्क्रयः

words.gloss: one for whom a penalty has been administered
words.gram: bahuvrīhi, m. nom. sg. pp. pra-√nī

hindi: दण्ड-प्रणीत कर्म से दण्ड को लाए।
english: One for whom a penalty has been administered should bring the penalty by work.
notes: daṇḍa-praṇīta: praṇīta = administered/led forward (cf. daṇḍa-praṇayana, glossary 8.1); rendered literally. upa-√nī = bring/lead near, literal; the sense 'pay off the penalty by working' is not stated. Hindi uses 'लाए' for the literal sense.
lines_deva: दण्ड.प्रणीतः कर्मणा दण्डम् उपनयेत्

words.gram: tat-puruṣa, m. nom. sg. pp. ā-√hṛ

words.gloss: in accordance with work and time

hindi: ध्वज द्वारा लाया गया आर्य-प्राण कर्म और काल के अनुरूप, अथवा आधे मूल्य से मुक्त किया जाए।
english: One of ārya life, brought by the banner (dhvaja-āhṛta), should be freed in accordance with work and time, or with half the price.
notes: dhvaja-āhṛta is rendered literally ('brought by/under the banner'); the intended sense (e.g. a captive taken in battle) is not stated. ārya-prāṇa as in unit 1.
lines_deva: आर्य.प्राणो ध्वज.आहृतः कर्म.काल.अनुरूपेण मूल्य.अर्धेन वा विमुच्येत
lines_iast: ārya.prāṇo dhvaja.āhṛtaḥ karma.kāla.anurūpeṇa mūlya.ardhena vā vimucyeta

words.gloss: of those born in the house, come by inheritance, obtained, bought
with the maintenance of the embryo not provided for

hindi: घर में उत्पन्न, दाय से आए, प्राप्त और खरीदे हुओं में से किसी एक दास को — आठ वर्ष से कम, बन्धुरहित, अनिच्छुक — नीच कर्म में, विदेश में, या गर्भवती दासी को, जिसके गर्भ के भरण-पोषण का प्रबन्ध नहीं किया गया, बिक्री या बन्धक में ले जाने वाले का प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है, और खरीदने वालों तथा सुनने वालों का।
english: For one who brings to sale or pledge any one of those born in the house, come by inheritance, obtained or bought — a slave under eight years, without relatives, unwilling — [for] low work, in a foreign country, or a pregnant female slave with the maintenance of the embryo not provided for: the first fine for rashness; and of the buyers and hearers.
notes: The loc. nīce karmaṇi / videśe are rendered 'in low work / in a foreign country'; 'for' in English is a loose bracketed link. Whether the locatives also apply to the female slave is not settled. bharmaṇyā is rare (maintenance, wages); 'maintenance' is a medium-confidence rendering. garbha = embryo (womb). vibandhu = without relatives (bandhu = relative, glossary). The nominative pūrvaḥ sāhasa-daṇḍaḥ stands without a link to the genitives, kept as printed.
lines_deva: गृहे.जात.दाय.आगत.लब्ध.क्रीतानाम् अन्यतमं दासम् ऊन.अष्ट.वर्षं विबन्धुम् अकामं नीचे कर्मणि विदेशे दासीं वा सगर्भाम् अप्रतिविहित.गर्भ.भर्मण्यां विक्रय.आधानं नयतः पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः, क्रेतृ.श्रोतॄणां च
lines_iast: gṛhe.jāta.dāya.āgata.labdha.krītānām anyatamaṃ dāsam ūna.aṣṭa.varṣaṃ vibandhum akāmaṃ nīce karmaṇi videśe dāsīṃ vā sagarbhām aprativihita.garbha.bharmaṇyāṃ vikraya.ādhānaṃ nayataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, kretṛ.śrotṝṇāṃ ca

words.gloss: of one who does not make
words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-√kṛ

hindi: दास को अनुरूप निष्क्रय के बदले आर्य न बनाने वाले का दण्ड बारह पण है, और करने तक संरोध है।
english: For one who does not make a slave an ārya for a suitable ransom, the penalty [is] twelve paṇas, and confinement until the doing.
notes: 'ca-ā.karaṇāt' is read ca + ā-karaṇāt ('until the doing'); alternative reading ca + akaraṇāt ('on account of not doing'), which would be the usual sandhi form cākaraṇāt. Both give a similar sense but are not the same. saṃrodha = confinement (restraint), literal.
lines_deva: दासम् अनुरूपेण निष्क्रयेण-आर्यम् अकुर्वतो द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, संरोधश् च-आ.करणात्
lines_iast: dāsam anurūpeṇa niṣkrayeṇa-āryam akurvato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, saṃrodhaś ca-ā.karaṇāt

hindi: दास के द्रव्य के उत्तराधिकारी ज्ञाति-जन हैं; उनके अभाव में स्वामी।
english: Of the slave's property the kin [are] the heirs; in their absence, the master.
notes: svāmī (nominative) is elliptical for 'the master [is the heir]'.
lines_deva: दास.द्रव्यस्य ज्ञातयो दायादाः, तेषाम् अभावे स्वामी
lines_iast: dāsa.dravyasya jñātayo dāyādāḥ, teṣām abhāve svāmī

hindi: स्वामी से अपनी दासी में उत्पन्न को माता सहित अदास जाने।
english: One should know [one] born of the master in his own female slave, together with the mother, [to be] a non-slave.
notes: samātṛka = 'having the mother along', so mother and child are both non-slaves. 'svāminaḥ ... jātam' = born of (to) the master; the genitive is taken as the father. 'to be' is bracketed.
lines_deva: स्वामिनः स्वस्यां दास्यां जातं समातृकम् अदासं विद्यात्
lines_iast: svāminaḥ svasyāṃ dāsyāṃ jātaṃ samātṛkam adāsaṃ vidyāt

words.gloss: one who thinks of the family's interest

hindi: यदि गृह्या, परिवार के प्रयोजन का चिन्तन करने वाली हो, उसकी माता, भाई और बहन अदास हों।
english: If [she is] a gṛhyā (of the house), one who thinks of the family's interest, her mother, brother and sister would be non-slaves.
notes: gṛhyā (from gṛha 'house') is obscure; kept as printed with the literal gloss 'of the house'. cintanī = one who thinks of/cares for; artha in kuṭumba-artha = interest (glossary 5.4). The woman is the slave woman of unit 23 (understood, not stated).
lines_deva: गृह्या चेत् कुटुम्ब.अर्थ.चिन्तनी माता भ्राता भगिनी च-अस्या अदासाः स्युः
lines_iast: gṛhyā cet kuṭumba.artha.cintanī mātā bhrātā bhaginī ca-asyā adāsāḥ syuḥ

hindi: दास या दासी को छुड़ाकर फिर बिक्री या बन्धक में ले जाने वाले का दण्ड बारह पण है, स्वयं कहने वालों को छोड़कर। यह दास-कल्प है।
english: For one who, having redeemed a male slave or a female slave, again brings [them] to sale or pledge, the penalty [is] twelve paṇas, except for the self-speakers (svayaṃ-vādin). Such is the dāsa-kalpa.
notes: svayaṃ-vādin is rendered literally 'self-speaker' (one who speaks for himself); the intended sense (e.g. those who themselves declare their willingness) is not stated, so low confidence for that phrase. kalpa is left untranslated (rule, section). The closing 'iti dāsa-kalpaḥ' follows the glossary formula 'Such is X' (3.7/9.3). The tokens '|', '25', '|' are the verse-end marks and number.
lines_deva: दासं दासीं वा निष्क्रीय पुनर् विक्रय.आधानं नयतो द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, अन्यत्र स्वयं.वादिभ्यः । २५ । इति दास.कल्पः
lines_iast: dāsaṃ dāsīṃ vā niṣkrīya punar vikraya.ādhānaṃ nayato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra svayaṃ.vādibhyaḥ | 25 | iti dāsa.kalpaḥ

hindi: कर्म करने वाले के कर्म-सम्बन्ध को समीप वाले जानें।
english: Those near should know the connection with work of a work-doer.
notes: āsanna (near) is not specified: it may mean neighbours, bystanders, or persons near the work. karma-kara = one who does work; karma-sambandha = connection with work, literal (the terms of the engagement).
lines_deva: कर्म.करस्य कर्म.सम्बन्धम् आसन्ना विद्युः

words.gloss: in accordance with work and time
one whose pay is not agreed

hindi: जैसा बातचीत में तय हुआ वेतन पाए; कर्म और काल के अनुरूप, जिसका वेतन तय नहीं हुआ।
english: [He] should receive pay as agreed; one whose pay is not agreed, in accordance with work and time.
notes: Elliptical second half: the verb labheta (and 'pay') is carried over, left unsupplied. Subject of labheta unstated. vetana = pay (glossary).
lines_deva: यथा.सम्भाषितं वेतनं लभेत, कर्म.काल.अनुरूपम् असम्भाषित.वेतनः

words.gloss: one whose pay is not agreed

hindi: फसलों का किसान, घी का ग्वाला, स्वयं व्यवहार किए गए पण्य का वैदेहक — जिसका वेतन तय नहीं हुआ, दसवाँ भाग पाए।
english: A farmer of the crops, a cowherd of the ghee, a trader of the wares dealt in by himself — [each] one whose pay is not agreed should receive a tenth part.
notes: The genitives sasyānām, sarpiṣām, paṇyānām are taken with the persons (and as the thing a tenth part is taken from); alternative: 'a tenth part of the crops / ghee / wares' respectively. vaidehaka = trader (glossary 8.4). daśa-bhāga = a tenth part (glossary 4.1). vyavahṛta literally 'dealt in/transacted'; ātmanā = by himself.
lines_deva: कर्षकः सस्यानां गो.पालकः सर्पिषां वैदेहकः पण्यानाम् आत्मना व्यवहृतानां दश.भागम् असम्भाषित.वेतनो लभेत
lines_iast: karṣakaḥ sasyānāṃ go.pālakaḥ sarpiṣāṃ vaidehakaḥ paṇyānām ātmanā vyavahṛtānāṃ daśa.bhāgam asambhāṣita.vetano labheta

hindi: किन्तु जिसका वेतन तय हुआ है, जैसा बातचीत में तय हुआ।
english: But one whose pay is agreed, [receives] as agreed.
notes: Verb carried over from unit 27 (labheta); bracketed in English only.
lines_deva: सम्भाषित.वेतनस् तु यथा.सम्भाषितम्

words.gloss: beginning with artisans, craftsmen, kuśīlavas, physicians, those living by speech, attendants

hindi: किन्तु कारु, शिल्पी, कुशीलव, चिकित्सक, वाणी से जीविका चलाने वाले, परिचारक आदि आशा-कारिक वर्ग — जैसा उस प्रकार का दूसरा करे, अथवा जैसा कुशल निर्धारित करें, वैसा वेतन पाए।
english: But the āśā-kārika group, beginning with artisans, craftsmen, kuśīlavas, physicians, those living by speech and attendants — as another of that kind would do, or as the skilled would fix, so [he] should receive pay.
notes: āśā-kārika is obscure and kept untranslated. kuśīlava kept (glossary 5.3). kāru = artisan, śilpin = craftsman (glossary 5.3). kuryāt has no object: 'as another of that kind would do' (work or fix pay) is ambiguous. vāg-jīvana = living by speech, literal. kuśala = skilled.
lines_deva: कारु.शिल्पि.कुशीलव.चिकित्सक.वाग्.जीवन.परिचारक.आदिर् आशा.कारिक.वर्गस् तु यथा-अन्यस् तद्.विधः कुर्याद् यथा वा कुशलाः कल्पयेयुस् तथा वेतनं लभेत
lines_iast: kāru.śilpi.kuśīlava.cikitsaka.vāg.jīvana.paricāraka.ādir āśā.kārika.vargas tu yathā-anyas tad.vidhaḥ kuryād yathā vā kuśalāḥ kalpayeyus tathā vetanaṃ labheta

hindi: साक्षी-प्रत्यय वाला ही हो।
english: [It] should be one with witnesses as the credence, only.
notes: sākṣi-pratyaya: pratyaya = credence/trust/proof; read as a bahuvrīhi (a matter resting on witnesses). Sense: only witnesses count. Low-medium confidence on the exact grammar.
lines_deva: साक्षि.प्रत्ययम् एव स्यात्

hindi: साक्षियों के अभाव में जिससे कर्म है, उससे पूछताछ करे।
english: In the absence of witnesses, from whom [there is] the work, from him [one] should question.
notes: yataḥ ... tataḥ is rendered literally; it may mean 'from the side from which the work (comes)' or 'from the person whose work it is'. Which party is questioned is thus unsettled. anu-√yuj (of an inquiry) = question (glossary 4.7). Subject unstated.
lines_deva: साक्षिणाम् अभावे यतः कर्म ततो ऽनुयुञ्जीत

hindi: वेतन लेने में दश-बन्ध का दण्ड है, अथवा छह पण।
english: In the taking of pay, the penalty [is] a daśa-bandha, or six paṇas.
notes: daśa-bandha is obscure ('ten-bound/ten-binding') and kept untranslated; do not read it as a tenth part without a commentary. ādāna = taking; who takes the pay and why a penalty follows is not stated.
lines_deva: वेतन.आदाने दश.बन्धो दण्डः, षट्.पणो वा

words.gram: m./n. loc. sg. pres. part. ātm. apa-√vyay (doubtful)

hindi: अपव्यय करते हुए में बारह पण का दण्ड है, अथवा पञ्च-बन्ध।
english: In one spending away, the penalty [is] twelve paṇas, or a pañca-bandha.
notes: apavyayamāna is obscure: taken as apa- + vyay (to spend/squander), literal 'spending away'; the alternatives (misappropriating, denying) cannot be excluded. pañca-bandha kept untranslated like daśa-bandha in unit 33. Low confidence.
lines_deva: अपव्ययमाने द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, पञ्च.बन्धो वा

words.gloss: hemmed in by river-current, flame, thieves, beasts of prey
by the giving of all that is his own, son, wife, self

hindi: नदी के वेग, ज्वाला, चोर, हिंस्र पशुओं से घिरा हुआ, सब अपना, पुत्र, पत्नी, स्वयं के दान से आर्त, त्राता को बुलाकर पार पहुँचा हुआ, कुशल द्वारा निर्दिष्ट वेतन दे।
english: One hemmed in by a river's current, flame, thieves or beasts of prey, [and] distressed by the giving of all that is his own, son, wife [and] self, having called a rescuer, [and] come through, should give the pay indicated by the skilled.

text_flags.why: niḥ before t gives nis-, not niṣ-; looks like a typing slip (possible)

notes: The sequence sarva-sva-putra-dāra-ātma-dāna is read as a list (all that is one's own, son, wife, self) with dāna 'giving' (a promise made to the rescuer). 'vyāla' = beasts of prey (glossary). 'niṣtīrṇa' literally 'crossed out', here 'come through'. kuśala-pradiṣṭa: pra-√diś = indicate.
lines_deva: नदी.वेग.ज्वाला.स्तेन.व्याल.उपरुद्धः सर्व.स्व.पुत्र.दार.आत्म.दानेन-आर्तस् त्रातारम् आहूय निष्तीर्णः कुशल.प्रदिष्टं वेतनं दद्यात्
lines_iast: nadī.vega.jvālā.stena.vyāla.uparuddhaḥ sarva.sva.putra.dāra.ātma.dānena-ārtas trātāram āhūya niṣtīrṇaḥ kuśala.pradiṣṭaṃ vetanaṃ dadyāt

words.gloss: regrets of giving by the distressed

hindi: इससे सर्वत्र आर्त-दान के अनुशयों की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, everywhere the anuśayas of giving by the distressed are explained.
notes: Formula 'tena X vyākhyātāḥ' (glossary 4.1). ārta-dāna-anuśaya: anuśaya = regret (literal); read as 'regrets over giving [made] by the distressed'. Alternative: ārta-dāna and anuśaya as two separate items ('gifts by the distressed, and regrets').
lines_deva: तेन सर्वत्र-आर्त.दान.अनुशया व्याख्याताः

words.gloss: by evil-mindedness and lack of discipline

hindi: पुंश्चली संगम के उपलिङ्गन से भोग पाए; किन्तु अतियाचना जीती जाए, अथवा दुर्मति और अविनय से।
english: A puṃścalī should obtain enjoyment (bhoga) from the upaliṅgana of the union; but excessive asking would be defeated, or [defeated] by evil-mindedness and lack of discipline.

text_flags.why: possible: the standard form is yācñā (with ñ); n for ñ looks like a typing slip (metre is 16 syllables either way)

notes: Verse (anuṣṭubh, two lines of 16). upaliṅgana (upa + liṅga) is obscure; literal 'indicating/marking'; alternatives 'embracing' or 'inference from a sign'; kept untranslated. puṃścalī rendered 'unchaste woman' (literally 'one who goes among men'). bhoga = enjoyment, literal (payment or hire not stated). The construction of 'daurmatya-avinayena vā' with jīyeta is uncertain; the claim defeated for greed or for bad conduct is the likely sense but not stated. The sentence is about a woman's claim; the unit is probably the end of a topic.
lines_deva: लभेत पुंश्चली भोगं सङ्गमस्य-उपलिङ्गनात्
अतियाच्ना तु जीयेत दौर्मत्य.अविनयेन वा
